name: What are the key differences between general SEO for help articles and GEO for Help Articles?
description: General SEO targets broad audiences; GEO for Help Articles focuses on local keywords and intent to attract users in specific geographic areas.

mainEntity.name: What are the key differences between general SEO for help articles and GEO for Help Articles?

acceptedAnswer.text: General SEO for help articles focuses on broad keywords and topics to attract a wide audience, aiming for overall organic visibility. In contrast, GEO for Help Articles specifically tailors content to include geographical modifiers, local intent, and location-based keywords (e.g., 'digital marketing solutions Dallas'). The primary goal of GEO is to capture search demand from users in specific localities, ensuring your helpful content is found by the right people in the right places, directly impacting local customer acquisition.
acceptedAnswer.description: General SEO targets broad audiences; GEO for Help Articles focuses on local keywords and intent to attract users in specific geographic areas.
